title: Tom Is Sick
text:
Tom is sick today. He has a fever and a cough. He stays in bed and drinks water.

His mother calls the doctor. The doctor says Tom needs rest and medicine. Tom feels better in three days.

questions.text: Why does Tom stay in bed?
options: He wants to play a game

questions.text: What can we guess about the doctor?
options: The doctor does not like children
The doctor lives in Tom's house

vocabulary.definition: a high body temperature when you are ill
a sound you make when you push air out of your throat
time when you do not work or move much
something you take to help you get better when you are ill

paragraph_translations: Tom está enfermo hoy. Tiene fiebre y tos. Se queda en la cama y bebe agua.
Su madre llama al médico. El médico dice que Tom necesita descanso y medicina. Tom se siente mejor en tres días.
